{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for the TREATMENT arm only
treatment_arm = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the number of patients in the treatment arm
treatment_count = len(treatment_arm)

# Check how many responded in the treatment arm
responded_count = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
treatment_response_fraction = responded_count / treatment_count

treatment_count, responded_count, treatment_response_fraction"}
